// Items: read-only for this slice (seeded by the scaffold's dev fixtures, not created through the API yet).
import type { Db } from "../../platform/db.ts";

export interface ItemRow { id: string; name: string; created_at: number }

export const findItemById = (db: Db, id: string): ItemRow | undefined => db.prepare("SELECT * FROM items WHERE id = ?").get(id) as ItemRow | undefined;
export interface ItemAvailability extends ItemRow { available: number }

/** Materialize only the requested page; availability never loads borrower identity or all active IDs. */
export const listItems = (db: Db, limit: number, offset: number): ItemAvailability[] => db.prepare(`
  SELECT page.*, NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM loans WHERE item_id = page.id AND status = 'active'
  ) AS available
  FROM (SELECT * FROM items ORDER BY name LIMIT ? OFFSET ?) AS page
  ORDER BY page.name
`).all(limit, offset) as ItemAvailability[];
export const countItems = (db: Db): number => (db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM items").get() as { n: number }).n;
export const insertItem = (db: Db, i: ItemRow): void => void db.prepare("INSERT INTO items (id, name, created_at) VALUES (@id, @name, @created_at)").run(i);
